stem.en: My brother and I ___ in the same class at school.

why.en: My brother and I means we, and with we the verb be is are.
why.uz: My brother and I = we (biz); we bilan be feʼli are shaklida boʻladi.
why.ru: My brother and I = we (мы); с we глагол be имеет форму are.

why.en: The negative of is is isn't (is not); do and does are not used with be.
why.uz: is ning inkor shakli isn't (is not); be feʼli bilan do/does ishlatilmaydi.
why.ru: Отрицание от is — isn't (is not); с глаголом be do/does не используются.

stem.en: I ___ not ready yet. Please wait five minutes.

why.en: With I, the verb be is am: I am not ready.
why.uz: I bilan be feʼli am boʻladi: I am not ready.
why.ru: С I глагол be имеет форму am: I am not ready.

stem.en: The shop ___ at eight o'clock every morning.

why.en: The shop is it, and in the present simple a verb after it takes -s: opens.
why.uz: The shop = it; Present Simple zamonida it dan keyin feʼlga -s qoʻshiladi: opens.
why.ru: The shop = it; в Present Simple после it глагол получает -s: opens.

stem.en: My parents ___ TV in the morning.

why.en: Parents means they, so the negative is don't + the base verb: don't watch.
why.uz: Parents = they (ular), shuning uchun inkor shakli don't + feʼlning asosiy shakli: don't watch.
why.ru: Parents = they (они), поэтому отрицание: don't + начальная форма глагола: don't watch.

why.ru: Your brother = he, поэтому вопрос строится с Does + начальная форма глагола.

options.en: Laylo goes to school by bus.
Laylo go to school by bus.
Laylo going to school by bus.
Laylo is go to school by bus.

why.en: Laylo is she, so the present simple verb takes -es: goes.
why.uz: Laylo = she; Present Simple zamonida she bilan feʼlga -es qoʻshiladi: goes.
why.ru: Laylo = she; в Present Simple с she глагол получает -es: goes.

stem.en: Sardor ___ two sisters and one brother.

why.en: With he or she (Sardor), the verb have becomes has.
why.uz: He yoki she (Sardor) bilan have feʼli has shakliga oʻtadi.
why.ru: С he или she (Sardor) глагол have превращается в has.

why.ru: С we отрицательная форма have got — haven't got.

why.uz: doesn't dan keyin feʼlning asosiy shakli keladi: has emas, have.
why.ru: После doesn't нужна начальная форма глагола: have, а не has.

stem.en: Look at ___ birds on the roof over there!

why.en: Birds is plural and they are far away (over there), so we use those.
why.uz: Birds koʻplikda va ular uzoqda (over there), shuning uchun those ishlatiladi.
why.ru: Birds — множественное число, и они далеко (over there), поэтому those.

stem.en: ___ is my new phone. Do you like it?

why.en: Phone is singular, so we need this; these and those are for plural nouns.
why.uz: Phone birlikda, shuning uchun this kerak; these va those koʻplik uchun.
why.ru: Phone — единственное число, поэтому this; these и those — для множественного.

stem.en: Are ___ your keys? — Yes, thank you!

why.en: Keys is plural, so the word before it must be plural too: these.
why.uz: Keys koʻplikda, shuning uchun undan oldingi soʻz ham koʻplikda boʻladi: these.
why.ru: Keys — множественное число, поэтому и указательное слово во множественном: these.

why.en: Apples is plural, so we say those apples are; this and that go with one thing.
why.uz: Apples koʻplikda: those apples are; this va that bitta narsa uchun.
why.ru: Apples — множественное число: those apples are; this и that — для одного предмета.
